text:
The Bayern Munich midfielder Joshua Kimmich has launched a stinging attack on the club’s “not Bayern-like” treatment of his teammate Jamal Musiala, who has a condition which causes seizures.
Senior Bayern figures have publicly questioned Musiala’s performances and contract after repeated seizures caused by a neurological condition, including two on the field in pre-season games, drawing protests from the players’ union Fifpro. Now Kimmich, the club’s vice-captain, has spoken out and warned Bayern risked undermining their family image.
“What I don’t understand is the way this is being communicated in public,” Kimmich said after Bayern’s 2-1 Champions League loss at Lille on Wednesday. “It must never happen that the burden is placed on a player. The club is obviously the top priority and bigger than a player, but it’s not bigger than a person. That’s an absolute no-go and it is not Bayern-like either.”
Kimmich also suggested Musiala’s run of injuries over the past two years, including a badly fractured leg at the Club World Cup last year, may have had more impact on his game than the neurological condition.
“It’s not the case that he has problems because he’s unprofessional,” Kimmich said. “He’s there every day trying to get the maximum out of himself.”
Bayern met with Musiala’s agents on Tuesday and clarified the timeline of events, dismissing speculation Musiala could have concealed the condition when he signed his last contract extension. Bayern said the club and Musiala’s representatives accepted he was first examined for seizure symptoms in April 2025, two months after the contract extension.
“This took place in consultation with FC Bayern and its medical unit immediately after the neurological symptoms first appeared,” Bayern said.
Musiala went public with his diagnosis in August after collapsing in pre-season games, leaving players and fans alarmed.
Bayern’s head coach, Vincent Kompany, said at the time the incidents were triggered by a change in the medication Musiala was taking. Musiala was rested for the start of the season and has since missed several games with a muscle issue.
Musiala came off the bench in the 76th minute of Bayern’s loss at Lille, which capped a bad week for the club. Harry Kane injured his ankle on Friday and faces months on the sidelines. Bayern have also lost the lead to Borussia Dortmund in the Bundesliga and slipped to 15th in the Champions League standings.
digest_he:
קשר באיירן מינכן וסגן הקהילה יוזואה קימיך יצא בביקורת קשה נגד ההנהלה בשל האופן שבו התייחסה פומבי למצבו של ג'מאל מוסאלה, הסובל מבעיה נוירולוגית הגורמת לפרכוסים. ראשי המועדון העלו שאלות לגבי יכולתו ויציבות חוזהו, דבר שעורר את תגובת ארגון השחקנים Fifpro וגרם לקימיך להזהיר שהתנהלות זו פוגעת בערכי המשפחתיות של המועדון.

קימיך הדגיש כי אין להעמיס את האחריות המלאה על השחקן באופן פומבי וציין כי מוסאלה משקיע מאמצים רבים באימונים. במקביל, הנהלת באיירן נפגשה עם סוכניו של השחקן כדי להבהיר את לוח הזמנים של האבחון הרפואי, שנערך מיד לאחר הופעת הסימפטומים באפריל 2025. האירועים מגיעים על רקע תקופה מאתגרת למודון, הכוללת הפסד בליגת האלופות לליל ופציעה קשה של הארי קיין.
